title: Verify legacy grace-bend preservation and explicit export omission
scope: Turn the known GP4 transition-2 source into a permanent regression and verify the narrow bend-transition omission independently of the already supported ordered grace/chord structure.
acceptance: Public Parse of testdata/gp4/fade-to-black.gp4 retains Transition=GraceEffectTransitionBend at zero-based track6/measure201/voice0/beat4/note0/grace0, Fret=22, RawFret=22, Duration=32, Velocity=95, before-beat placement. Record the source bytes and exact owning address, without inferring a bend curve.

Load the same fixture using pinned AlphaTab and align by voice/string/owning nongrace beat: its inserted grace is raw beat4 followed by owning raw beat5 in bar201, has no bend points, slide, or hammer. Record this as a source-importer limitation; do not use matching absence to claim grace-bend preservation.

Add an isolated valid programmatic grace with Transition=Bend, exact fret2, duration32, Forte velocity, no RawFret, and before/on-beat cases. The only conversion loss is gp8.omit.grace-bend-transition at the owning note. Strict rejects it with zero bytes, an unrelated allowed code cannot bypass it, and allowing exactly that omission succeeds.

On allowed export, assert exact ordered grace placement/owning string and note identity, no fabricated bend curve, and that Go reparse and pinned consumer lack the bend transition. Keep existing None/Slide/Hammer and ordered grace-chord controls passing.

Record the regression, importer limitation, and retained export-omission disposition in the ledger and inventory. This policy ticket can close without a retaining bend oracle; a future preservation ticket requires independently verified curve semantics and must not derive them merely from adjacent frets.
exclusions: No grace/chord model redesign or invented transition-to-curve mapping. RawFret provenance and authored-versus-derived grace timing stay separate. No claim that pinned importer proves the original transition semantics.

reproduction.instructions: Read the existing GP4 fixture through Parse and inspect Tracks[6].Measures[201].Voices[0].Beats[4].Notes[0].Effect.Graces[0]. The 4-byte grace record at offset70913 is 16 06 02 02 (hex), with transition byte02 at70915. Then use conformanceGrace(2,DurationThirtySecond,Forte,false,0,GraceEffectTransitionBend,false) in semanticExportProbeSong for isolated policy assertions. AlphaTab original-fixture raw bar201 beat4 is the grace; raw beat5 is the owner.

needs-evidence: Ordered grace/chord behavior is covered. The remaining bend-transition mapping is unproven; pinned legacy readGrace explicitly ignores transition 2. A faithful fixture/oracle is still required.

Narrow the remaining question to GraceEffectTransitionBend. Ordered grace beats, grace chords and placement already have conformance coverage; do not redesign them. Obtain a concrete binary grace-transition-2 example and establish its authored bend semantics with a retaining independent consumer. Pinned Gp3To5Importer.readGrace explicitly ignores case 2, so comparison against that importer cannot prove the transition. If a faithful GPIF grace-note bend mapping is demonstrated, specify its endpoints, timing and chord/string ownership in a bounded implementation follow-up. Otherwise record the exact oracle/target limitation and retain gp8.omit.grace-bend-transition; do not invent a curve from adjacent frets.
